translations.literal: When Fang La rebelled, You joined the generals in recovery operations and wherever he went the enemy was swept aside.
translations.idiomatic: When Fang La rebelled, You joined the generals in the recovery campaign, and wherever he went the enemy was swept aside.

sentences.zh: 婺寇復作，守留友攝兵曹，為殄滅計。

translations.literal: When bandits rose again in Wu, the prefect retained You to act as military aide and plan their extermination.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose again in Wu Prefecture, the prefect retained You as acting military aide and charged him with planning their extermination.

sentences.zh: 友請往諭之，既次浦江，賊望風解去。

translations.literal: You asked to go and reason with them; when he halted at Pujiang the bandits dispersed at the sight of him.
translations.idiomatic: You asked to go and reason with them. When he halted at Pujiang, the bandits dispersed at the sight of him.

sentences.zh: 復單騎次武義，賊眾持釘一榼置其前，友正色叱之曰：「汝等何速死耶？

translations.literal: He again went alone on horseback to Wuyi; the bandit host placed a jar of nails before him; You sternly rebuked them: "Why are you in such haste to die?"
translations.idiomatic: He again rode alone to Wuyi. The bandit host placed a jar of nails before him. You sternly rebuked them: "Why are you in such haste to die?"

sentences.zh: 」賊首李德壯之，亟麾退，一境貼然，婺人圖像祀之。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Li De admired him and quickly ordered a withdrawal; the whole region was pacified, and the people of Wu painted his image and worshipped him.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Li De admired him and quickly ordered a withdrawal. The whole region was pacified, and the people of Wu painted his portrait and worshipped him.

sentences.zh: 進直徽猷閣、製置司參謀官，同種師中解太原圍。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Direct Attendant of the Hall of Imperial Splendor and staff officer of the Military Commission, and joined Zhong Shizhong in relieving the siege of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to direct attendant of the Hall of Imperial Splendor and staff officer of the military commission, and joined Zhong Shizhong in relieving the siege of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 友遣兵三千奪榆次，得糧萬餘斛。

translations.literal: You sent three thousand troops to seize Yuci and obtained more than ten thousand hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: You sent three thousand troops to seize Yuci and obtained more than ten thousand hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 明日，大軍進榆次十里而止，友亟白師中：「地非利，將三面受敵。

translations.literal: The next day the main army advanced to within ten li of Yuci and halted; You urgently reported to Shizhong: "The ground is unfavorable—we shall be attacked on three sides."
translations.idiomatic: The next day the main army advanced to within ten li of Yuci and halted. You urgently reported to Shizhong, "The ground is unfavorable—we shall be attacked on three sides."

sentences.zh: 」論不合，友仰天歎曰：「事去矣！

translations.literal: Their views did not agree; You looked to heaven and sighed: "The affair is lost!"
translations.idiomatic: They could not agree. You looked to heaven and sighed, "The affair is lost!"

sentences.zh: 」迨曉，兵果四合，矢石如雨，敵益以鐵騎，士卒奔潰。

translations.literal: By dawn the enemy had closed in from four sides; arrows and stones fell like rain; the enemy added iron cavalry; the soldiers broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn the enemy had closed in from four sides. Arrows and stones fell like rain, iron cavalry was added to the assault, and the soldiers broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 敵執友謂曰：「降則赦汝。

translations.literal: The enemy seized You and said: "Surrender and you shall be pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: The enemy seized You and said, "Surrender and you shall be pardoned."

sentences.zh: 」友厲聲曰：「男兒死耳！

translations.literal: You cried out: "A man dies—that is all!"
translations.idiomatic: You cried out, "A man dies—that is all!"

sentences.zh: 」遂遇害。

translations.literal: He was thereupon killed.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon killed.

sentences.zh: 帝書「忠節傳家」四字旌其閭，官其後八人。

translations.literal: The Emperor wrote the four characters "Loyalty Passed Down in the Family" to honor his lane, and eight of his descendants were given office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote the four characters "Loyalty Passed Down in the Family" to honor his household, and eight of his descendants received official appointments.

sentences.zh: 友體貌英偉，膽雄萬夫，謀畫機密，出人意表。

translations.literal: You was imposing in stature, bold as ten thousand men, and in secret planning always beyond expectation.
translations.idiomatic: You was imposing in stature, bold as ten thousand men, and in secret planning always beyond expectation.

sentences.zh: 嘗語子弟曰：「天下承平日久，武事玩弛，萬一邊書告警，馬革裹屍，乃吾素誌。

translations.literal: He once told his sons and younger brothers: "The realm has long been at peace and military affairs neglected; should an alarm come from the frontier, to die wrapped in horsehide is my lifelong wish."
translations.idiomatic: He once told his sons and younger brothers, "The realm has long been at peace and military affairs neglected. Should an alarm come from the frontier, to die wrapped in horsehide is my lifelong wish."

sentences.zh: 他日收吾骸，足心黑子為識也。

translations.literal: "When you recover my bones hereafter, a black mark on the sole of the foot shall be the sign."
translations.idiomatic: "When you recover my bones hereafter, a black mark on the sole of the foot shall be the sign."

sentences.zh: 」其忠誠許國根於天性如此。

translations.literal: His loyal devotion to the state was rooted in his nature to this degree.
translations.idiomatic: His loyal devotion to the state was rooted in his nature to this degree.

sentences.zh: 郝仲連，昌元人。

translations.literal: Hao Zhonglian was a native of Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Zhonglian was a native of Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年，金人犯河中，守臣席益遁去。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyan the Jurchens invaded Hedong; the defending official Xi Yi fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyan the Jurchens invaded Hedong, and the defending official Xi Yi fled.

sentences.zh: 仲連時為貴州防禦使，宣撫範致虛遣節制河東軍馬，屯河中，就權府事。

translations.literal: Zhonglian was then Defense Commissioner of Guizhou; Pacification Commissioner Fan Zhixu dispatched him to command Hedong horse and foot forces, encamped at Hedong, and he was temporarily given charge of prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglian was then defense commissioner of Guizhou. Pacification Commissioner Fan Zhixu dispatched him to command the Hedong horse and foot forces, encamped at Hedong, and temporarily placed him in charge of prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 金將婁宿以重兵壓城，仲連率眾力戰，外援不至，度不能守，先自殺其家人，城陷不屈，及其子皆遇害。

translations.literal: The Jurchen general Lou Su pressed the city with a heavy force; Zhonglian led the people in fierce fighting; outside aid did not come; seeing he could not hold, he first killed his own family; when the city fell he would not submit; he and his son were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen general Lou Su pressed the city with a heavy force. Zhonglian led the people in fierce fighting, but no outside aid came. Seeing that he could not hold the city, he first killed his own family. When the city fell he refused to submit, and he and his son were both killed.

sentences.zh: 後贈中侍大夫、明州觀察使。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously awarded Vice Director of the Palace Attendants Service and Observation Commissioner of Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was later posthumously granted the rank of vice director of the Palace Attendants Service and observation commissioner of Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 劉惟輔，涇州人。

translations.literal: Liu Weifu was a native of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Weifu was a native of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以同州觀察使為熙河馬步軍副總管。

translations.literal: He served as Observation Commissioner of Tongzhou and Deputy Commander-in-Chief of Xijing horse and foot forces.
translations.idiomatic: He served as observation commissioner of Tongzhou and deputy commander-in-chief of the Xijing horse and foot forces.

sentences.zh: 金人既得秦州，經略使張深遣惟輔將三千騎禦之。

translations.literal: After the Jurchens took Qinzhou, Military Commissioner Zhang Shen dispatched Weifu with three thousand cavalry to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jurchens took Qinzhou, Military Commissioner Zhang Shen dispatched Weifu with three thousand cavalry to resist them.

sentences.zh: 金前軍逾鞏州，距熙才百里，惟輔留軍熟羊城，以千八百騎夜趨新店。

translations.literal: The Jurchen vanguard crossed Gongzhou and was only a hundred li from Xi; Weifu left troops at Shuyang Fort and with eighteen hundred cavalry rushed by night to Xindian.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen vanguard crossed Gongzhou and was only a hundred li from Xi. Weifu left troops at Shuyang Fort and with eighteen hundred cavalry rushed by night to Xindian.

sentences.zh: 黎明軍進，短兵相接，殺傷大當。

translations.literal: At dawn the army advanced; at close quarters they fought; casualties on both sides were heavy.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the army advanced. They fought at close quarters, and casualties on both sides were heavy.

sentences.zh: 惟輔舞槊刺其先鋒將孛堇黑鋒，洞胸墮馬死，敵為奪氣退。

translations.literal: Weifu brandished his spear and pierced the vanguard commander Borijin Heifeng through the chest; he fell from his horse dead and the enemy lost heart and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Weifu brandished his spear and pierced the vanguard commander Borijin Heifeng through the chest. He fell from his horse dead, and the enemy lost heart and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 深檄隴右都護張嚴往追之，至鳳翔境上，惟輔不欲聽嚴節制，乃自別道由吳山出寶雞，獲金遊騎。

translations.literal: Shen dispatched Longyou Protector Zhang Yan to pursue; reaching the border of Fengxiang, Weifu did not wish to obey Yan's command and took a separate route through Wushan to emerge at Baoji, capturing Jurchen patrol cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Shen dispatched Longyou Protector Zhang Yan in pursuit. Reaching the border of Fengxiang, Weifu did not wish to obey Yan's command and took a separate route through Wushan to emerge at Baoji, where he captured Jurchen patrol cavalry.

sentences.zh: 嚴擁大兵及金人於五里坡，金人知之，伏兵坡下，嚴與曲端期而不至，徑前，遇伏死之。

translations.literal: Yan led a large force to meet the Jurchens at Wulipu; the Jurchens knew of it and hid troops below the slope; Yan had agreed to meet Qu Duan but he did not arrive; Yan went straight forward, met the ambush, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yan led a large force to meet the Jurchens at Wulipu. The Jurchens knew of it and hid troops below the slope. Yan had agreed to rendezvous with Qu Duan, but Qu Duan did not arrive. Yan went straight forward, met the ambush, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 惟輔自石鼻砦遁歸。

translations.literal: Weifu fled back from Shibi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Weifu fled back from Shibi Fort.

sentences.zh: 金人略熙河，惟輔將去，顧熙河尚有積粟，恐金人因之以守，急出悉焚之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens overran Xihe; as Weifu was about to leave, he saw that Xihe still had stored grain and feared the Jurchens would use it to hold the region; he hurried out and burned it all.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens overran Xihe. As Weifu was about to leave, he saw that Xihe still held stored grain and feared the Jurchens would use it to hold the region. He hurried out and burned it all.

sentences.zh: 金人追及，所部皆走，惟輔與親信數百匿山寺中，遣人詣夏國求附，夏國不受。

translations.literal: The Jurchens caught up; his troops all fled; Weifu and several hundred trusted followers hid in a mountain temple; he sent men to the Xia state seeking refuge; the Xia state would not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens caught up, and his troops all fled. Weifu and several hundred trusted followers hid in a mountain temple and sent men to the Xia state seeking refuge, but the Xia state would not accept them.

sentences.zh: 其親信軍詣金人降，金人執惟輔，誘之百方，終不言。

translations.literal: His trusted troops went to the Jurchens and surrendered; the Jurchens seized Weifu and tried every means to entice him; he would not speak to the end.
translations.idiomatic: His trusted troops went over to the Jurchens and surrendered. The Jurchens seized Weifu and tried every means to win him over, but he would not speak to the end.

sentences.zh: 金人怒，捽以出，惟輔奮首曰：「死犬！

translations.literal: The Jurchens were enraged and dragged him out; Weifu raised his head and said: "Dead dog!"
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens were enraged and dragged him out. Weifu raised his head and cried, "Dead dog!"

sentences.zh: 斬即斬，吾頭豈汝捽也。

translations.literal: "Cut if you will cut—my head is not yours to drag!"
translations.idiomatic: "Cut if you will cut—my head is not yours to drag about!"

sentences.zh: 」顧坐上客曰：「國家不負汝，一旦遽降敵耶？

translations.literal: He turned to the guests seated there and said: "The state has not failed you—will you suddenly surrender to the enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: He turned to the guests seated there and said, "The state has not failed you—will you suddenly surrender to the enemy?"

sentences.zh: 」即閉口不復言而死。

translations.literal: He then closed his mouth and spoke no more and died.
translations.idiomatic: He then closed his mouth and spoke no more until he died.

sentences.zh: 張浚聞之，承製贈昭化軍節度使，賻金帛布以二百計，官子孫十二人，立廟成州，號忠烈。

translations.literal: When Zhang Jun heard of it, by provisional order he posthumously awarded Military Commissioner of Zhaohua Army, gave more than two hundred items of gold, silk, and cloth, gave office to twelve descendants, and established a temple at Chengzhou with the title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Jun heard of it, by provisional order he posthumously granted Weifu the rank of military commissioner of Zhaohua Army, gave more than two hundred items of gold, silk, and cloth, granted official posts to twelve descendants, and established a temple at Chengzhou with the title Loyal and Fierce.

sentences.zh: 有高子孺，狄道人。

translations.literal: There was also Gao Ziru of Dizhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Gao Ziru of Dizhou.

sentences.zh: 知蘭州龕穀砦，聞惟輔尚存，固守以待。

translations.literal: He was magistrate of Qian'gu Fort in Lanzhou; hearing that Weifu still survived, he held firm and waited.
translations.idiomatic: He was magistrate of Qian'gu Fort in Lanzhou. Hearing that Weifu still survived, he held firm and waited.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，先刃其家而後死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he first cut down his family and then died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he first killed his family and then died.

sentences.zh: 韓青為熙河馬步軍第六將，間行從惟輔，為金人所擒，亦罵不絕口而死。

translations.literal: Han Qing was Sixth Commander of Xijing horse and foot forces; he traveled secretly with Weifu, was captured by the Jurchens, and also cursed without cease until he died.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qing was sixth commander of the Xijing horse and foot forces. He traveled secretly with Weifu, was captured by the Jurchens, and also cursed without cease until he died.

sentences.zh: 牛皓，福津人。

translations.literal: Niu Hao was a native of Fujin.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Hao was a native of Fujin.

sentences.zh: 為武功大夫、川陝宣撫後軍中部將。

translations.literal: He served as Military Grand Master and Middle Commander of the Rear Army of the Chuan-Shaan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He served as military grand master and middle commander of the rear army of the Chuan-Shaan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，金右都監撒離曷與其熙河經略使慕洧欲犯秦川，宣撫副使吳玠遣諸校分道伺之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing the Jurchen Right Director Salihe and his Xijing Military Commissioner Mu Wei intended to invade Qinchuan; Deputy Pacification Commissioner Wu Jie dispatched officers by separate routes to watch them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shaoxing the Jurchen right director Salihe and his Xijing military commissioner Mu Wei intended to invade Qinchuan. Deputy Pacification Commissioner Wu Jie dispatched officers by separate routes to watch them.

sentences.zh: 皓至瓦吾穀，與金將虎山遇，皓所部步卒不滿二百，乃下與戰，謂其從曰：「吾所以舍馬者，欲與若等同死也。

translations.literal: Hao reached Wuwu Valley and met the Jurchen commander Hushan; Hao's foot soldiers numbered fewer than two hundred; he dismounted to fight and told his followers: "The reason I leave my horse is that I wish to die together with you."
translations.idiomatic: Hao reached Wuwu Valley and met the Jurchen commander Hushan. Hao's foot soldiers numbered fewer than two hundred. He dismounted to fight and told his followers, "The reason I leave my horse is that I wish to die together with you."

sentences.zh: 」金人見皓異於他人，欲招之，皓力戰死。

translations.literal: The Jurchens saw that Hao was unlike others and wished to recruit him; Hao fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens saw that Hao was unlike the others and wished to recruit him, but Hao fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 有承信郎高萬，且罵且戰，與熙河路部將任安、宣撫司隊官秦元、薛琪、張亨皆死於陣。

translations.literal: There was also Gentleman for Trust Gao Wan, who cursed as he fought; he and Xijing Route Commander Ren An, Pacification Commission squad officers Qin Yuan, Xue Qi, and Zhang Heng all died in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Gentleman for Trust Gao Wan, who cursed as he fought. He and Xijing Route commander Ren An, and pacification commission squad officers Qin Yuan, Xue Qi, and Zhang Heng all died in the battle line.

sentences.zh: 金人相謂：「真健兒也。

translations.literal: The Jurchens said to one another: "Truly stalwart men."
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens said to one another, "Truly stalwart men."

sentences.zh: 」後皓、安皆贈翊衛大夫，官其家五人，贈萬等三官，錄其子。

translations.literal: Later Hao and An were both posthumously awarded Grand Master of the Imperial Guard; five members of each family were given office; Wan and the others were posthumously promoted three ranks and their sons were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hao and An were both posthumously granted the rank of grand master of the imperial guard; five members of each family received official appointments; Wan and the others were posthumously promoted three ranks and their sons were enrolled in office.

sentences.zh: 魏彥明，開封人。

translations.literal: Wei Yanming was a native of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yanming was a native of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 通判延安府。

translations.literal: He served as Vice-Prefect of Yan'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice-prefect of Yan'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，金人陷府東城，而西城猶堅守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan the Jurchens took the eastern city of the prefecture while the western city still held firm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan the Jurchens took the eastern city of the prefecture while the western city still held firm.

sentences.zh: 金人並兵入鄜延，王庶自當鄜州來路，遣統製官龐世才當延安來路。

translations.literal: The Jurchens combined forces and entered Yan-Yan; Wang Shu himself blocked the route from Yanzhou and dispatched Controller Pang Shicai to block the route from Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens combined forces and entered the Yan-Yan region. Wang Shu himself blocked the route from Yanzhou and dispatched Controller Pang Shicai to block the route from Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 天大雪，世才戰敗，自是金兵專圍西城。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell from heaven; Shicai was defeated in battle; from then on the Jurchen troops devoted themselves to besieging the western city.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow fell from the sky. Shicai was defeated in battle, and from then on the Jurchen troops devoted themselves to besieging the western city.

sentences.zh: 初受圍時，彥明與權府事劉選分地而守，彥明當東壁，空家貲以賞戰士，金人不敢犯。

translations.literal: At the first siege Yanming and Liu Xuan, who held temporary charge of prefectural affairs, divided the ground and defended; Yanming held the eastern wall, emptied his family's wealth to reward the warriors, and the Jurchens did not dare attack.
translations.idiomatic: At the first siege Yanming and Liu Xuan, who temporarily held charge of prefectural affairs, divided the ground and defended. Yanming held the eastern wall, emptied his family's wealth to reward the warriors, and the Jurchens did not dare attack.

sentences.zh: 王庶子之道未弱冠，率老弱乘城。

translations.literal: Wang Shu's son Zhidao was not yet twenty and led the old and weak onto the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shu's son Zhidao was not yet twenty and led the old and weak onto the wall.

sentences.zh: 金人晝夜攻城，閱十有三日城陷，彥明坐子城樓上，金人並其家執之，諭使速降。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked day and night; after thirteen days the city fell; Yanming sat in the secondary gate tower; the Jurchens seized his whole family and urged him to surrender quickly.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens attacked day and night. After thirteen days the city fell. Yanming sat in the secondary gate tower. The Jurchens seized his whole family and urged him to surrender quickly.

sentences.zh: 彥明曰：「吾家食宋祿，犬輩使背吾君乎？

translations.literal: Yanming said: "My family has eaten Song salary—would you dogs have me betray my lord?"
translations.idiomatic: Yanming said, "My family has eaten Song salary—would you dogs have me betray my lord?"

sentences.zh: 」婁宿怒殺之。

translations.literal: Lou Su in anger killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Su in anger killed him.

sentences.zh: 詔贈中大夫，官一子。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously awarded him Grand Master and gave office to one son.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously granted him the rank of grand master and gave an official post to one son.

sentences.zh: 劉士英，宣和間為溫州教授。

translations.literal: Liu Shiying served as instructor of Wenzhou during the Xuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiying served as instructor of Wenzhou during the Xuanhe era.

sentences.zh: 方臘陷處州，州人爭具舟欲遁，士英奮謂不當避。

translations.literal: When Fang La took Chuzhou the people of the prefecture all scrambled to prepare boats intending to flee; Shiying declared forcefully that they ought not flee.
translations.idiomatic: When Fang La took Chuzhou the people of the prefecture all scrambled to prepare boats intending to flee. Shiying declared forcefully that they ought not flee.

sentences.zh: 自郡將而下皆排沮之，士英獨身任責，推郡茂才石礪為謀主，治兵峙糧，籍保伍，分其地為八隅，委官統率，以鍾為約，令民聞鍾聲則趨所守堞。

translations.literal: From the prefect down all dissuaded him; Shiying alone took responsibility; he recommended the prefectural graduate Shi Li as strategist; he gathered troops and stored grain, registered the baojia system, divided the ground into eight sectors, delegated officials to command each, and used the bell as signal—when the people heard the bell they were to hurry to their assigned ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: From the prefect down all dissuaded him, but Shiying alone took responsibility. He recommended the prefectural graduate Shi Li as strategist, gathered troops and stored grain, registered the baojia system, divided the ground into eight sectors, delegated officials to command each, and used the bell as signal—when the people heard the bell they were to hurry to their assigned ramparts.

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊來攻，拒守凡四十餘日，官軍繼至，賊潰去。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits came to attack; they held out for more than forty days; government troops arrived in succession and the bandits broke and left.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits came to attack. The defenders held out for more than forty days until government troops arrived in succession and the bandits broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，通判太原府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingkang he served as Vice-Prefect of Taiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingkang era he served as vice-prefect of Taiyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金人入境，帥臣張孝純欲避之，士英率通判方笈、將官王稟力止孝純。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens entered the territory the commander Zhang Xiaochun wished to flee; Shiying led Vice-Prefect Fang Ji and officer Wang Bin to forcefully stop Xiaochun.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens entered the territory the commander Zhang Xiaochun wished to flee. Shiying led Vice-Prefect Fang Ji and officer Wang Bin to forcefully stop Xiaochun.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，稟赴火死，士英持短兵接戰，死之。

translations.literal: When the city fell Bin threw himself into the fire and died; Shiying took a short weapon and fought at close quarters and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Bin threw himself into the fire and died. Shiying took a short weapon, fought at close quarters, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 笈在金，因講和使附書言二人死節，後刻石於衢、溫二州。

translations.literal: Ji was in Jin territory; through the peace envoy he sent a letter stating how the two men died for their duty; later stones were carved at Qu and Wen prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was in Jin territory. Through the peace envoy he sent a letter stating how the two men died for their duty, and later commemorative stones were carved at Qu and Wen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 翟興，字公祥，河南伊陽人。

translations.literal: Di Xing, courtesy name Gongxiang, was a native of Yiyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Di Xing, style name Gongxiang, was a native of Yiyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 少以勇聞。

translations.literal: From youth he was known for courage.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was known for courage.

sentences.zh: 劇賊王伸起，興與弟進應募擊賊，號大翟、小翟。

translations.literal: When the fierce bandit Wang Shen rose, Xing and his younger brother Jin answered the recruitment to strike bandits and were called Great Di and Little Di.
translations.idiomatic: When the fierce bandit Wang Shen rose, Xing and his younger brother Jin answered the recruitment to strike bandits and were called Great Di and Little Di.

sentences.zh: 金人犯京師，西道總管王襄檄興統領在城軍馬。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens invaded the capital, Western Route Commander-in-Chief Wang Xiang ordered Xing to command the army and horses in the city.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens invaded the capital, Western Route Commander-in-Chief Wang Xiang ordered Xing to command the army and horses in the city.

sentences.zh: 以保護陵寢功補承信郎，辟京西北路兵馬副鈐轄，為陝西宣撫司前軍統製。

translations.literal: For protecting the imperial tombs he was given Gentleman for Trust, recruited as Deputy Military Controller of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and made Front Army Commander of the Shaanxi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: For protecting the imperial tombs he was granted the rank of Gentleman for Trust, recruited as deputy military controller of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and made front army commander of the Shaanxi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 高世由以澤州降金，金以為西京留守。

translations.literal: Gao Shiyou surrendered Zezhou to the Jurchens and the Jurchens made him Western Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shiyou surrendered Zezhou to the Jurchens, and the Jurchens made him Western Capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 興與進提步卒數百，卷甲夜趨洛陽，擒世由等斬之。

translations.literal: Xing and Jin led several hundred foot soldiers, rolled up their armor and rushed by night to Luoyang, captured Shiyou and the others and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: Xing and Jin led several hundred foot soldiers, rolled up their armor, and rushed by night to Luoyang, where they captured Shiyou and the others and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 群盜冀德、韓清出沒汝、洛間，興以輕騎追襲，德就擒，清僅以身免。

translations.literal: The bandit chiefs Ji De and Han Qing lurked between Ru and Luo; Xing pursued with light cavalry; De was captured and Qing barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chiefs Ji De and Han Qing lurked between Ru and Luo. Xing pursued with light cavalry. De was captured and Qing barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 會進為叛將楊進所害，賊乘勢擊敗官軍，興帥餘眾拒賊，保伊川。

translations.literal: Just then Jin was killed by the rebel general Yang Jin; the bandits seized the momentum and defeated the government army; Xing led the remaining force to resist the bandits and held Yichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Jin was killed by the rebel general Yang Jin. The bandits seized the momentum and defeated the government army. Xing led the remaining force to resist the bandits and held Yichuan.

sentences.zh: 明年，訴進死事於朝，以興代進為京西北路安撫製置使兼京西北路招討使，兼知河南府。

translations.literal: The next year he reported Jin's death in service to the court; Xing was made in Jin's place Pacification and Military Commissioner of the Jingxi Northwest Route and Pacification Commissioner of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and concurrently magistrate of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he reported Jin's death in service to the court. Xing was appointed in Jin's place pacification and military commissioner of the Jingxi Northwest Route and pacification commissioner of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and concurrently prefect of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 楊進屯鳴皋山北，興與子琮帥鄉兵時出擾之，進懼，棄輜重南走，興邀擊於魯山縣，進中流矢死，餘眾潰去，西京平。

translations.literal: Yang Jin encamped north of Minggao Mountain; Xing and his son Cong led local militia out from time to time to harass him; Jin grew afraid, abandoned baggage and fled south; Xing intercepted him at Lushan County; Jin was struck by a stray arrow and died; the remainder scattered; the Western Capital was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jin encamped north of Minggao Mountain. Xing and his son Cong led local militia out from time to time to harass him. Jin grew afraid, abandoned his baggage, and fled south. Xing intercepted him at Lushan County. Jin was struck by a stray arrow and died, the remainder scattered, and the Western Capital was pacified.

sentences.zh: 賊王俊據汝州，興引兵攻之，俊棄城去，退保繖蓋山。

translations.literal: The bandit Wang Jun held Ruzhou; Xing led troops to attack him; Jun abandoned the city and withdrew to hold Sangan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Wang Jun held Ruzhou. Xing led troops to attack him. Jun abandoned the city and withdrew to hold Sangan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 興進攻，免胄大呼曰：「賊識我乎？

translations.literal: Xing pressed the attack, removed his helmet and cried loudly: "Do you bandits know me?"
translations.idiomatic: Xing pressed the attack, removed his helmet, and cried loudly, "Do you bandits know me?"

sentences.zh: 我翟總管也。

translations.literal: "I am Commander Di!"
translations.idiomatic: "I am Commander Di!"

sentences.zh: 」眾皆披靡，遂破之。

translations.literal: The host all scattered and he broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The host all scattered, and he broke them.

sentences.zh: 金人犯河陽、鞏縣、永安軍，興遣子琮與搏戰，屢捷，追至澠池。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded Heyang, Gong County, and Yong'an Army; Xing dispatched his son Cong to fight them; he won repeatedly and pursued to Mianchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens invaded Heyang, Gong County, and Yong'an Army. Xing dispatched his son Cong to fight them. He won repeatedly and pursued to Mianchi.

sentences.zh: 詔授河南孟、汝、唐州鎮撫使兼知河南府，轉武略大夫兼閣門宣讚舍人，寓治伊陽。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him Pacification Commissioner of Henan, Meng, Ru, and Tang prefectures and concurrently magistrate of Henan Prefecture; he was transferred to Military Strategist Grand Master and concurrently Palace Gate Proclamation Officer; he administered from Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him pacification commissioner of Henan, Meng, Ru, and Tang prefectures and concurrently prefect of Henan Prefecture. He was transferred to military strategist grand master and concurrently palace gate proclamation officer, administering from Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 時河東、北雖陷，土豪聚眾保險，興遣蠟書結約之，向密、王簡、王英輩皆願受節制。

translations.literal: Though Hedong and Hebei had fallen, local strongmen gathered forces and held the passes; Xing sent letters sealed in wax to join them in alliance; Xiang Mi, Wang Jian, Wang Ying, and others all wished to accept his command.
translations.idiomatic: Though Hedong and Hebei had fallen, local strongmen gathered forces and held the passes. Xing sent letters sealed in wax to join them in alliance. Xiang Mi, Wang Jian, Wang Ying, and others all wished to accept his command.

sentences.zh: 奏上，高宗嘉之，授河東、北路軍馬使，遍檄山砦，由是汾、澤、潞、懷、衛間山砦首領皆應命。

translations.literal: When the memorial reached the throne Emperor Gaozong praised it and appointed him Military Commissioner of Hedong and Hebei Routes; he issued proclamations throughout the mountain forts, and thereby the chiefs of the mountain forts between Fen, Ze, Lu, Huai, and Wei all answered his call.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial reached the throne Emperor Gaozong praised it and appointed him military commissioner of the Hedong and Hebei routes. He issued proclamations throughout the mountain forts, and thereby the chiefs of the mountain forts between Fen, Ze, Lu, Huai, and Wei all answered his call.

sentences.zh: 劉豫將遷汴，以興屯伊陽，憚之，遣蔣頤持書誘興以王爵。

translations.literal: When Liu Yu was about to move the capital to Bian, because Xing was encamped at Yiyang he feared him and dispatched Jiang Yi with a letter to entice Xing with a princely title.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Yu was about to move the capital to Bian, because Xing was encamped at Yiyang he feared him and dispatched Jiang Yi with a letter to entice Xing with a princely title.

sentences.zh: 興斬頤焚其書，豫計不行，乃陰遣人啖裨將楊偉以利，偉殺興，攜其首奔豫。

translations.literal: Xing beheaded Yi and burned the letter; Yu's plan failed; he then secretly sent men to bribe the deputy general Yang Wei with profit; Wei killed Xing and carried his head to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Xing beheaded Yi and burned the letter. Yu's plan failed, and he then secretly sent men to bribe the deputy general Yang Wei with profit. Wei killed Xing and carried his head to Yu.

sentences.zh: 或云：賂偉為內應，以兵徑犯中軍，興奮擊墜馬死。

translations.literal: Some say: bribing Wei as an inside agent, troops directly struck the headquarters; Xing fought fiercely, fell from his horse, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Some say that Wei was bribed as an inside agent, troops struck the headquarters directly, Xing fought fiercely, fell from his horse, and died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈保信軍節度使。

translations.literal: When word reached the court he was posthumously awarded Military Commissioner of Baoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court he was posthumously granted the rank of military commissioner of Baoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 興威貌魁偉，每怒，須輒張。

translations.literal: Xing was imposing in stature and presence; whenever he grew angry his beard bristled.
translations.idiomatic: Xing was imposing in stature and presence; whenever he grew angry his beard bristled.

sentences.zh: 軍食不繼，士以菽粟雜藜藿食之，激以忠義，無不奮厲。

translations.literal: When army provisions did not continue the soldiers ate beans, millet, and wild greens mixed together; stirred by loyalty and righteousness none failed to fight fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: When army provisions ran short the soldiers ate beans, millet, and wild greens mixed together. Stirred by loyalty and righteousness, none failed to fight fiercely.

sentences.zh: 在河南累年，金人不敢犯諸陵。

translations.literal: For many years in Henan the Jurchens did not dare violate the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: For many years in Henan the Jurchens did not dare violate the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 詔賜軍名「忠護」。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed on the army the name "Loyal Guard."
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed on the army the name "Loyal Guard."

sentences.zh: 子琮，沈勇有父風，繼興為鎮撫使；

translations.literal: His son Cong was deep and brave with his father's bearing and succeeded Xing as Pacification Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: His son Cong was deep and brave with his father's bearing and succeeded Xing as pacification commissioner;

sentences.zh: 琳，閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Lin, Palace Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Lin served as palace gate attendant.

sentences.zh: 進字先之。

translations.literal: Jin, courtesy name Xianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Jin, style name Xianzhi.

sentences.zh: 以捕盜勞補下班殿侍，累功充京西第一將。

translations.literal: For capturing bandits he was given Lower-Rank Palace Attendant; through accumulated merit he filled the First Commander of Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: For capturing bandits he was granted the rank of lower-rank palace attendant, and through accumulated merit he rose to first commander of Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 坐熙河帥劉法涇原戰失利，降官停任，尋敘復。

translations.literal: Because Xijing Commander Liu Fa was defeated in battle on the Jingyuan Route he was demoted and suspended from office; soon he was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xijing Commander Liu Fa was defeated in battle on the Jingyuan Route he was demoted and suspended from office, but soon he was restored.

sentences.zh: 女真歸故地，改河北第四將。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens returned the old territory he was transferred to Fourth Commander of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens returned the old territory he was transferred to fourth commander of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 往至遂城，會契丹兵奄至，都統製劉延慶以進為先鋒，與契丹戰於幽州石料岡、盧溝河皆捷。

translations.literal: When he reached Suicheng the Khitan army suddenly arrived; Commander-in-Chief Liu Yanqing made Jin vanguard; he fought the Khitans at Shiliaogang and Lugou River and won both times.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Suicheng the Khitan army suddenly arrived. Commander-in-Chief Liu Yanqing made Jin vanguard. He fought the Khitans at Shiliaogang and Lugou River and won both times.

sentences.zh: 又與契丹大將遇於峰山，力戰彌日，契丹潰去。

translations.literal: He again met a great Khitan general at Fengshan; they fought fiercely for a whole day and the Khitans broke and left.
translations.idiomatic: He again met a great Khitan general at Fengshan. They fought fiercely for a whole day, and the Khitans broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 金人犯京師，朝廷密詔西道總管王襄會兵三萬赴京城，至葉縣，襄欲引兵而南，進諫止之，因分軍遣進持書而西。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens invaded the capital the court secretly ordered Western Route Commander Wang Xiang to combine thirty thousand troops and hurry to the capital; reaching Yexian, Xiang wished to lead the army south; Jin remonstrated and stopped him, and so divided the army and sent Jin west with a letter.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens invaded the capital the court secretly ordered Western Route Commander Wang Xiang to combine thirty thousand troops and hurry to the capital. Reaching Yexian, Xiang wished to lead the army south. Jin remonstrated and stopped him, and so the army was divided and Jin was sent west with a letter.

sentences.zh: 時經略使範致虛已合五路軍馬次潼關，以進統河南民兵，收復西京。

translations.literal: At the time Military Commissioner Fan Zhixu had already combined five-route army and horse forces at Tongguan and made Jin command Henan local militia to recover the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Military Commissioner Fan Zhixu had already combined five-route army and horse forces at Tongguan and made Jin command Henan local militia to recover the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 進至福昌，遣兵襲金營。

translations.literal: Jin reached Fuchang and dispatched troops to raid the Jurchen camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jin reached Fuchang and dispatched troops to raid the Jurchen camp.

sentences.zh: 時金遊騎往來外邑，進設伏擒之。

translations.literal: At the time Jurchen patrol cavalry came and went in the outer districts; Jin set an ambush and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jurchen patrol cavalry came and went in the outer districts. Jin set an ambush and captured them.

sentences.zh: 金人逼靈山砦，進父子兄弟與之戰，潰圍至高都，集鄉兵七百人，夜行晝伏，五日至洛城，夜半破關入，擒高世由。

translations.literal: The Jurchens pressed Lingshan Fort; Jin, his father, brothers, and sons fought them, broke out of the encirclement to Gaodu, gathered seven hundred local militia, traveled by night and hid by day, reached Luoyang in five days, broke through the gate at midnight and entered, and captured Gao Shiyou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens pressed Lingshan Fort. Jin, his father, brothers, and sons fought them, broke out of the encirclement to Gaodu, gathered seven hundred local militia, traveled by night and hid by day, reached Luoyang in five days, broke through the gate at midnight and entered, and captured Gao Shiyou.

sentences.zh: 再捷於伊陽白草塢。

translations.literal: He won again at Baicao Wu in Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: He won again at Baicao Wu in Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 都總管孫昭遠至洛陽，以進戍澠池界，授武義大夫、閣門宣讚舍人。

translations.literal: Overall Commander Sun Zhaoyuan reached Luoyang and made Jin garrison the Mianchi border; he was granted Military Righteousness Grand Master and Palace Gate Proclamation Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commander Sun Zhaoyuan reached Luoyang and made Jin garrison the Mianchi border. He was granted the rank of military righteousness grand master and palace gate proclamation officer.

sentences.zh: 金人犯白浪隘，將渡河，進破之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded Bailang Pass intending to cross the river; Jin defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens invaded Bailang Pass intending to cross the river. Jin defeated them.

sentences.zh: 未幾，洛陽再陷，進在伊陽，裒散亡才千人。

translations.literal: Before long Luoyang fell again; Jin was at Yiyang and gathered the scattered remnant—only a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Luoyang fell again. Jin was at Yiyang and gathered the scattered remnant—only a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 金人犯薛封，進選精銳三百人，夜縱火斫其營，焚死者甚眾。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded Xuefeng; Jin selected three hundred elite troops, set fires by night and cut into their camp; many were burned to death.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens invaded Xuefeng. Jin selected three hundred elite troops, set fires by night, and cut into their camp; many were burned to death.

sentences.zh: 又戰於驢道堰，生擒金將翟海，追至梅花穀。

translations.literal: He fought again at Lüdao Yan, captured the Jurchen commander Zhai Hai alive, and pursued to Meihua Valley.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again at Lüdao Yan, captured the Jurchen commander Zhai Hai alive, and pursued to Meihua Valley.

sentences.zh: 賊冀德、韓清嘯聚南陽，進間道擊之，德降，繼斬清於艾蒿平。

translations.literal: The bandits Ji De and Han Qing gathered and roared at Nanyang; Jin took a hidden route to strike them; De surrendered and he then beheaded Qing at Aihap Ping.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits Ji De and Han Qing gathered and roared at Nanyang. Jin took a hidden route to strike them. De surrendered, and he then beheaded Qing at Aihap Ping.

sentences.zh: 勒兵抵龍門，屢與金人夾河戰，乘勝入洛陽。

translations.literal: He led troops to Longmen and repeatedly fought the Jurchens on opposite banks of the river; seizing victory he entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops to Longmen and repeatedly fought the Jurchens on opposite banks of the river. Seizing victory, he entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「彼砦尚固，城未可守。

translations.literal: Some said: "Their forts are still strong—the city cannot be held."
translations.idiomatic: Some said, "Their forts are still strong—the city cannot be held."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: He would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: He would not listen.

sentences.zh: 金人聚懷、衛、蒲、孟數州之眾薄城下，斧諸門入，進率士卒巷戰，次子亮死之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens gathered forces from Huai, Wei, Pu, and Meng prefectures and pressed beneath the city; they broke through every gate and entered; Jin led soldiers in lane fighting; his second son Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens gathered forces from Huai, Wei, Pu, and Meng prefectures and pressed beneath the city. They broke through every gate and entered. Jin led soldiers in lane fighting, and his second son Liang was killed.

sentences.zh: 遷武功大夫、閣門宣讚舍人，充京西北路兵馬都鈐轄，尋授馬步軍副總管，升本路製置使，兼知河南府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Military Achievement Grand Master and Palace Gate Proclamation Officer, filled Military Controller of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and soon was given Deputy Commander-in-Chief of horse and foot forces, promoted to Route Military Commissioner of this circuit, and concurrently magistrate of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military achievement grand master and palace gate proclamation officer, appointed military controller of the Jingxi Northwest Route, and soon given deputy commander-in-chief of horse and foot forces, promoted to route military commissioner of this circuit, and concurrently prefect of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會東京留守杜充所招巨寇楊進號「沒角牛」者，擁兵數萬，殘害汝、洛間。

translations.literal: Just then Eastern Capital Intendant Du Chong had recruited the great bandit Yang Jin, called "Ox Without Horns," who led tens of thousands of troops and ravaged between Ru and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Eastern Capital Intendant Du Chong had recruited the great bandit Yang Jin, called "Ox Without Horns," who led tens of thousands of troops and ravaged the region between Ru and Luo.

sentences.zh: 進謂其兄興欲力除之。

translations.literal: Jin told his elder brother Xing that he wished to eliminate him by force.
translations.idiomatic: Jin told his elder brother Xing that he wished to eliminate Yang Jin by force.

sentences.zh: 會楊進遣數百騎絕水犯進營，進乘半渡擊之，追賊數十里，破賊四砦，馬驚墜塹，為賊所害。

translations.literal: Just then Yang Jin dispatched several hundred cavalry to cross the water and attack Jin's camp; Jin struck them while half across, pursued the bandits several tens of li, broke four bandit forts; his horse startled and fell into a ditch and he was killed by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Yang Jin dispatched several hundred cavalry to cross the water and attack Jin's camp. Jin struck them while they were half across, pursued the bandits several tens of li, and broke four bandit forts. His horse startled, fell into a ditch, and he was killed by the bandits.

sentences.zh: 贈左武大夫、忠州刺史，官其後五人。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Left Military Grand Master and Prefect of Zhongzhou; five of his descendants were given office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the rank of left military grand master and prefect of Zhongzhou, and five of his descendants received official appointments.

sentences.zh: 朱蹕，湖州安吉人，知錢塘縣。

translations.literal: Zhu Bi, a native of Anji in Huzhou, was magistrate of Qiantang County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Bi, a native of Anji in Huzhou, was magistrate of Qiantang County.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，金人陷杭州，初犯餘杭，守臣康允之退保赭山。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan the Jurchens took Hangzhou; they first attacked Yuhang; the defending official Kang Yunzhi withdrew to hold Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianyan the Jurchens took Hangzhou. They first attacked Yuhang, and the defending official Kang Yunzhi withdrew to hold Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 蹕白允之率弓手、士軍前路拒敵，使杭民為逃死計。

translations.literal: Bi told Yunzhi to lead bowmen and local troops forward to resist the enemy and let the people of Hangzhou plan escape.
translations.idiomatic: Bi told Yunzhi to lead bowmen and local troops forward to resist the enemy and give the people of Hangzhou a chance to escape.

sentences.zh: 行二十里，遇金兵，蹕兩中流矢，左右掖至天竺山，猶能率鄉兵禦敵。

translations.literal: After traveling twenty li they met Jurchen troops; Bi was struck by two arrows in succession; his attendants supported him to Tianzhu Mountain and he could still lead local militia to resist the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: After traveling twenty li they met Jurchen troops. Bi was struck by two arrows in succession. His attendants supported him to Tianzhu Mountain, and he could still lead local militia to resist the enemy.

sentences.zh: 後數日遇害。

translations.literal: Several days later he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later he was killed.

sentences.zh: 時兀术自安吉進兵，過獨鬆關，曰：「南朝若以羸兵數百守此，吾豈能遽度哉！」

translations.literal: At the time Wuzhu advanced from Anji; passing Dusong Pass he said: "If the Southern Court had kept several hundred weak troops to guard this, how could I have crossed it so quickly!"
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wuzhu advanced from Anji. Passing Dusong Pass he said, "If the Southern Court had kept several hundred weak troops to guard this, how could I have crossed it so quickly!"

sentences.zh: 朱良者，字良伯，吳郡人。

translations.literal: Zhu Liang, courtesy name Liangbo, was a native of Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Liang, style name Liangbo, was a native of Wu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 世儒科。

translations.literal: His family for generations pursued the Confucian examinations.
translations.idiomatic: His family for generations pursued the Confucian examinations.

sentences.zh: 建炎中，為海鹽縣尉。

translations.literal: During the Jianyan era, he served as lieutenant of Haiyan County.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianyan reign period, he served as lieutenant of Haiyan County.

sentences.zh: 金兵入境，良謂僚友曰：「今日乃忠臣義士死國之時也。

translations.literal: When Jin troops entered the territory, Liang said to his colleagues, "Today is the time for loyal ministers and righteous men to die for the state.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin forces crossed the border, Liang told his colleagues, "Today is the day for loyal ministers and righteous men to die for their country.

sentences.zh: 」被甲執戈，集所部百餘人奮而前，擊金兵數人死，眾為披靡，然力不敵，竟死。

translations.literal: " He donned armor, took up a halberd, gathered more than a hundred men under his command, and charged forward. He killed several Jin soldiers, and the enemy ranks broke before him, but his strength was insufficient; in the end he died.
translations.idiomatic: " He put on armor, seized a halberd, rallied the hundred-odd men under his command, and charged. He killed several Jin soldiers and put the enemy to flight, but he was outmatched and fell in the end.

sentences.zh: 事聞，官其子思，後守漢陽。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, his son Si was given an official appointment; later he served as prefect of Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, his son Si was granted an official post; he later served as prefect of Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 方允武者，衢州人。

translations.literal: Fang Yunwu was a native of Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Yunwu was a man of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 武學上舍，補官為常州宜興巡檢。

translations.literal: A senior student at the Military Academy, he received an appointment as patrol inspector of Yixing in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Having graduated from the Military Academy as a senior student, he was appointed patrol inspector of Yixing in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，金人入縣之金泉鄉，允武率土軍、鄉民迎敵，殺獲數級，奪弓箭與旗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, when the Jin entered Jinquan township in the county, Yunwu led local troops and village militia to meet the enemy, killing and capturing several of them and seizing bows, arrows, and banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jianyan era, when Jin forces entered Jinquan township in his county, Yunwu led local soldiers and village militia against them, killing and capturing several men and seizing bows, arrows, and banners.

sentences.zh: 後遇金兵梅嶺村，力戰而沒。

translations.literal: Later he encountered Jin troops at Meiling Village, fought fiercely, and perished.
translations.idiomatic: He later encountered Jin troops at Meiling Village, fought to the last, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈兩官，官其家二人。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously promoted him by two ranks and granted official appointments to two members of his family.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered him posthumously promoted by two ranks and granted official appointments to two members of his household.

sentences.zh: 龔楫字濟道，兵部侍郎原之孫，世以儒學顯。

translations.literal: Gong Ji, styled Jidao, was the grandson of Gong Yuan, Vice Minister of War; his family had long been distinguished in Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Ji, courtesy name Jidao, was the grandson of Gong Yuan, Vice Minister of War; for generations his family had been eminent in Confucian scholarship.

sentences.zh: 楫懦如不勝衣。

translations.literal: Ji appeared so frail that he seemed scarcely able to bear the weight of his clothes.
translations.idiomatic: Ji looked so slight and frail that he seemed barely able to support the weight of his own garments.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，聞金人陷郡縣，輒忿恚不食，念有以自見而不可得。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan, whenever he heard that the Jin had overrun prefectures and counties, he would burn with indignation and refuse to eat, longing for some way to prove himself yet finding none.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Jianyan era, whenever he heard that Jin forces had overrun prefectures and counties, he seethed with anger and refused to eat, aching for some way to distinguish himself yet finding no means to do so.

sentences.zh: 兀术據和州，以偏師萬人築堡新塘，遏絕濡須之路。

translations.literal: Wuzhu held Hezhou and sent a detached force of ten thousand men to build a fort at Xintang, cutting off the route through Ruxu.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu held Hezhou and dispatched a detached column of ten thousand men to build a fort at Xintang, severing the road through Ruxu.

sentences.zh: 楫率家僮百餘人襲之，鄉里從者三千餘人，獲千戶二，係累者數百人，輜重稱是。

translations.literal: Ji led more than a hundred household retainers in an assault on it; more than three thousand from the countryside joined him. They captured two chiliarchs, took several hundred prisoners in bonds, and seized baggage in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Ji led more than a hundred household retainers in a raid on the fort; over three thousand men from the surrounding countryside rallied to him. They captured two chiliarchs, took several hundred prisoners in bonds, and seized commensurate stores of baggage and supplies.

sentences.zh: 縱遣所掠州民父母妻子，將歸於滁、和鎮撫司。

translations.literal: He released the parents, wives, and children of people from the prefecture whom the enemy had seized, intending to escort them to the pacification commissions of Chuzhou and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He freed the parents, wives, and children of local people whom the Jin had seized, intending to escort them to the pacification commissions of Chuzhou and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 遇金兵大至，乃取道圩上，金騎兵據其衝，不得前，眾多赴水死。

translations.literal: When a large Jin force arrived, they took a path along the embankment. Jin cavalry blocked their advance, and they could not get through; many threw themselves into the water and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: When a large Jin force arrived, they tried to withdraw along the embankment. Jin cavalry blocked their path, and with no way forward, many hurled themselves into the water and drowned.

sentences.zh: 楫麾其眾曰：「今日鬥死亦足稱義士，自棄溝瀆無益也。

translations.literal: Ji rallied his men, saying, "To die fighting today is enough to earn the name of righteous men; to cast oneself into a ditch and die for nothing is of no use.
translations.idiomatic: Ji rallied his followers, saying, "To die fighting today is enough to win the name of righteous men; to throw ourselves into a ditch and perish for nothing will serve no purpose.

sentences.zh: 」戰敗，為金人所獲，猶挺劍刺其一人，罵不絕口，金人臠割之。

translations.literal: " They were defeated and captured by the Jin. Ji still thrust his sword and stabbed one of them, cursing without cease, and the Jin cut him to pieces.
translations.idiomatic: " They were defeated and taken by the Jin. Even then Ji drove his sword into one of them and cursed without pause, until the Jin hacked him limb from limb.

sentences.zh: 年二十二。

translations.literal: He was twenty-two years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was twenty-two years old.

sentences.zh: 金人初至新塘，有蔣子春者，教授里中。

translations.literal: When the Jin first arrived at Xintang, there was a man named Jiang Zichun who taught in the village.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin first reached Xintang, a village teacher named Jiang Zichun lived there.

sentences.zh: 金人見其挾書，又人物秀整，喜之，欲命以官，子春怒罵，乃殺之。

translations.literal: The Jin saw that he carried books and that his person was refined and handsome; pleased with him, they wished to appoint him to office. Zichun cursed them in fury, and they killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin saw that he carried books and that he was refined and handsome in bearing; pleased with him, they wished to give him an official post. Zichun railed at them in fury, and they killed him.

sentences.zh: 李亙者，字可大，兗州乾封人。

translations.literal: Li Gen, styled Kedai, was a native of Qianfeng in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gen, courtesy name Kedai, was a native of Qianfeng in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 少好學，有知慮。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning and possessed sound judgment.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood he loved learning and had a keen mind for affairs.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Daguan.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Daguan era.

sentences.zh: 徐處仁當國，擢尚書郎官。

translations.literal: When Xu Churen held power, he was promoted to an office in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Churen held power at court, Gen was promoted to a post in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 建炎末，金人犯淮南，亙不及避，劉豫使守大名。

translations.literal: At the end of Jianyan, when the Jin invaded Huainan, Gen was unable to escape; Liu Yu appointed him to guard Daming.
translations.idiomatic: At the close of the Jianyan era, when Jin forces invaded Huainan, Gen could not flee in time; Liu Yu appointed him to hold Daming.

sentences.zh: 與淩唐佐謀，密陳豫可取狀告於朝。

translations.literal: Together with Ling Tangzuo he plotted in secret, sending a detailed report to the court on how Liu Yu could be overthrown.
translations.idiomatic: He conspired with Ling Tangzuo and secretly sent the court a detailed report on how Liu Yu might be overthrown.

sentences.zh: 募卒劉全、宋萬、僧惠欽輩十餘，往返事泄，全、萬、惠欽為邏者所得，亙坐死。

translations.literal: He recruited more than ten men including Liu Quan, Song Wan, and the monk Huiqin to travel back and forth; the affair was exposed, Quan, Wan, and Huiqin were seized by scouts, and Gen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited more than ten men, including Liu Quan, Song Wan, and the monk Huiqin, to carry messages back and forth; the plot was exposed, Quan, Wan, and Huiqin were seized by scouts, and Gen was put to death.

sentences.zh: 後贈官，立祠曰湣忠。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously given an official rank, and a shrine called Minzhong was established for him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously granted an official rank, and a shrine called Minzhong was established in his honor.

sentences.zh: 又有武顯大夫孫安道，為應天府兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: There was also Sun Anda, a Grand Master of Martial Eminence, who served as military controller of Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Sun Anda, a Grand Master of Martial Eminence, who served as military controller of Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 城陷不得歸，謀挺身還朝，為人所告而死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he could not return home; he plotted to make his way back to court, was denounced by someone, and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he could not return home. He plotted to make his way back to the Song court, was reported by an informer, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 後贈忠州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously made Prefect of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously appointed Prefect of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 淩唐佐字公弼，徽州休寧人。

translations.literal: Ling Tangzuo, styled Gongbi, was a native of Xiuning in Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Tangzuo, courtesy name Gongbi, was a native of Xiuning in Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 元符三年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Yuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of the Yuanfu era.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，提點京畿刑獄，加直秘閣，知南京。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan he served as Judicial Intendant of the Capital Circuit, was additionally made a Direct Attendant of the Privy Repository, and was appointed prefect of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Jianyan era he served as Judicial Intendant of the Capital Circuit, was additionally made a Direct Attendant of the Privy Repository, and was appointed prefect of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 南京陷，劉豫因使為守。

translations.literal: When Nanjing fell, Liu Yu had him appointed to hold the city.
translations.idiomatic: When Nanjing fell, Liu Yu compelled him to serve as its prefect.

sentences.zh: 唐佐與宋汝為密疏其虛實，遣人持蠟書告於朝。

translations.literal: Tangzuo and Song Ruwei secretly mapped out the enemy's true condition and sent men bearing wax-sealed letters to report to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Tangzuo and Song Ruwei secretly mapped the enemy's true condition and dispatched men bearing wax-sealed letters to report to the court.

sentences.zh: 江、淮都督呂頤浩過常州，得唐佐從孫憲，授保義郎、閣門祗候，俾持帛書遺之。

translations.literal: Lu Yihao, Grand Coordinator of the Jiang-Huai region, passed through Changzhou and obtained Tangzuo's grandnephew Xian; he was granted the rank of Defender of Righteousness and made a Gate Attendant, and was sent with a silk letter to deliver to him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yihao, Grand Coordinator of the Jiang-Huai region, passed through Changzhou and obtained Tangzuo's grandnephew Xian; Xian was granted the rank of Defender of Righteousness and made a Gate Attendant, then sent with a silk letter to deliver to Tangzuo.

sentences.zh: 憲至睢陽，事泄，豫捕唐佐並其家，憲脫歸。

translations.literal: When Xian reached Suiyang the affair was exposed; Yu seized Tangzuo together with his family, but Xian escaped and returned.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian reached Suiyang the plot was exposed; Yu seized Tangzuo together with his family, but Xian slipped away and returned.

sentences.zh: 唐佐見豫，責以大義，豫怒，斬唐佐境上。

translations.literal: When Tangzuo was brought before Yu, he rebuked him on grounds of righteousness; Yu was enraged and executed Tangzuo at the border.
translations.idiomatic: When Tangzuo was brought before Yu, he rebuked him on grounds of righteousness; enraged, Yu had Tangzuo executed at the border.

sentences.zh: 李橫復潁昌，言於朝，詔贈徽猷閣待制。

translations.literal: When Li Heng recovered Yingchang, he reported this to the court, and an edict posthumously made Tangzuo a Pending Attendant of the Huixiu Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Heng recovered Yingchang, he reported the matter to the court, and an edict posthumously made Tangzuo a Pending Attendant of the Huixiu Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 楊粹中，真定府人。

translations.literal: Yang Cuizhong was a native of Zhending Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Cuizhong was a man of Zhending Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，金人大入，時粹中知濮州，固守不下。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan the Jin invaded on a large scale; at that time Cuizhong was prefect of Puzhou and held firm without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jianyan era the Jin invaded on a large scale; Cuizhong was then prefect of Puzhou and held the city without yielding.

sentences.zh: 粘罕以濮小郡，易之，將官姚端乘其不意，夜搗其營，直犯中軍，粘罕跣足走，僅以身免。

translations.literal: Nianhan, thinking Puzhou a small commandery and taking it lightly, had the general Yao Duan take advantage of his inattention and strike his camp by night, driving straight into the headquarters; Nianhan fled barefoot and barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Nianhan, deeming Puzhou a small commandery and treating it lightly, had the general Yao Duan strike his camp by night while he was off guard, driving straight into headquarters; Nianhan fled barefoot and barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 遂急攻城，凡三十三日而陷，端率死士突出。

translations.literal: He then pressed the siege urgently; after thirty-three days the city fell, and Duan led his die-hard troops in a breakout.
translations.idiomatic: He then pressed the siege hard; after thirty-three days the city fell, and Duan led his die-hard troops in a breakout.

sentences.zh: 粘罕入其城，粹中登浮圖不下，粘罕嘉其忠義，許以不死，乃以粹中歸。

translations.literal: When Nianhan entered the city, Cuizhong ascended a pagoda and would not come down; Nianhan admired his loyalty and righteousness and promised he would not be killed, then took Cuizhong away with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Nianhan entered the city, Cuizhong climbed a pagoda and refused to come down; Nianhan admired his loyalty and righteousness, promised he would not be killed, and took Cuizhong away with him.

sentences.zh: 粹中竟不屈而死，守禦官杜績亦死之。

translations.literal: Cuizhong in the end would not submit and died; the defensive officer Du Ji also died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Cuizhong in the end refused to submit and died; the defensive officer Du Ji also died with him.

sentences.zh: 贈粹中徽猷閣待制。

translations.literal: Cuizhong was posthumously made a Pending Attendant of the Huixiu Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Cuizhong was posthumously made a Pending Attendant of the Huixiu Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 強霓，自金歸宋，為武功大夫、閣門宣讚舍人、知環州、環慶路統製軍馬兼沿邊安撫使。

translations.literal: Qiang Ni, having returned from the Jin to Song, served as Grand Master of Martial Achievement, Gate Proclamation Attendant, prefect of Huanzhou, and Commander of Military Affairs on the Huan-Qing Circuit with concurrent duties as Frontier Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang Ni, having returned from Jin territory to Song service, served as Grand Master of Martial Achievement, Gate Proclamation Attendant, prefect of Huanzhou, and Commander of Military Affairs on the Huan-Qing Circuit, with concurrent duties as Frontier Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 隆興間，金兵圍環州，與其弟武經大夫、環慶路統領沿邊忠義軍馬震堅守孤城，招誘使降，不屈，城陷死焉。

translations.literal: During the Longxing era, when Jin troops besieged Huanzhou, he and his younger brother Zhen, a Grand Master of Martial Classics and Commander of Loyal and Righteous Forces along the Huan-Qing frontier, held the isolated city to the end; the enemy tried to induce them to surrender, but they would not submit, and when the city fell they died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longxing era, when Jin forces besieged Huanzhou, he and his younger brother Zhen, a Grand Master of Martial Classics and Commander of Loyal and Righteous Forces along the Huan-Qing frontier, held the isolated city to the end. The enemy tried to induce them to surrender, but they refused, and when the city fell they perished.

sentences.zh: 興州駐紮御前諸軍統製吳挺言於朝，並贈觀察使，立廟西和州，賜額旌忠。

translations.literal: Wu Ting, Commander of the Imperial Armies stationed at Xingzhou, reported this to the court; both were posthumously made Observation Commissioners, a temple was established for them in Xihe Prefecture, and the name Jingzhong was bestowed upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ting, Commander of the Imperial Armies stationed at Xingzhou, reported the matter to the court; both brothers were posthumously made Observation Commissioners, a temple was established for them in Xihe Prefecture, and the name Jingzhong was bestowed upon it.

sentences.zh: 康傑者，權知扶風縣，與金將馮宣戰，宣愛而欲招之，傑奮曰：「吾今也當死於陣，不能降敵。

translations.literal: Kang Jie was acting prefect of Fufeng County; he fought the Jin general Feng Xuan. Xuan admired him and wished to win him over, but Jie cried out, "I ought now to die on the battlefield and cannot surrender to the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Jie was acting prefect of Fufeng County. He fought the Jin general Feng Xuan, who admired him and wished to win him over, but Jie cried out, "I ought now to die on the battlefield; I cannot surrender to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 」宣殺之。

translations.literal: " Xuan killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuan killed him.

sentences.zh: 李伸者，知天興縣，堅守不下，城陷，曰：「吾豈使敵殺我。

translations.literal: Li Shen was prefect of Tianxing County and held firm without yielding; when the city fell he said, "How could I let the enemy kill me?
translations.idiomatic: Li Shen was prefect of Tianxing County and held the city without yielding; when it fell he said, "How could I let the enemy kill me?

sentences.zh: 」遂自殺。

translations.literal: " He then took his own life.
translations.idiomatic: " He then took his own life.

sentences.zh: 郭僎，字同升，開封祥符縣人。

translations.literal: Guo Fu, styled Tongsheng, was a native of Xiangfu County in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Fu, courtesy name Tongsheng, was a native of Xiangfu County in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 以父任調海州東海縣尉，權祥符縣尉。

translations.literal: Through his father's position he was transferred to serve as lieutenant of Donghai in Haizhou, and acted as lieutenant of Xiangfu County.
translations.idiomatic: Through his father's position he was transferred to serve as lieutenant of Donghai in Haizhou and acted as lieutenant of Xiangfu County.

sentences.zh: 時童貫子師閔死，敕葬邑境，僎任道途之役。

translations.literal: At that time Tong Guan's son Shimmin died, and an edict ordered burial within the county's territory; Fu was charged with duties on the road.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tong Guan's son Shimmin died, and an edict ordered him buried within the county's territory; Fu was charged with duties along the route.

sentences.zh: 貫命徹民屋之當道者，僎先籍童氏屋數十間欲毀之，貫遽令勿毀，由是民屋得免。

translations.literal: Guan ordered the demolition of commoners' houses that stood in the way; Fu first registered several dozen houses belonging to the Tong family and intended to destroy them, but Guan immediately ordered that they not be destroyed, and thus commoners' houses were spared.
translations.idiomatic: Guan ordered the demolition of commoners' houses that stood in the way; Fu first registered several dozen houses belonging to the Tong family and intended to destroy them, but Guan immediately ordered that they be spared, and so the commoners' houses were saved.

sentences.zh: 再調濱州招安丞，又為亳州蒙城丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to serve as Assistant Magistrate of Zhao'an in Binzhou, and later became Assistant Magistrate of Mengcheng in Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to serve as Assistant Magistrate of Zhao'an in Binzhou, and later became Assistant Magistrate of Mengcheng in Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 令以鹽科邑民，僎爭之不可。

translations.literal: The magistrate imposed a salt levy on the people of the county; Fu argued against it without success.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate imposed a salt levy on the people of the county; Fu protested but could not stop it.

sentences.zh: 郡守以僎丞鹿邑，中貴人楊逢周率軍士二百人，以捕寇為名入邑境，所至騷動。

translations.literal: The prefect transferred Fu to serve as assistant magistrate of Luyi; the eunuch Yang Fengzhou led two hundred soldiers and entered the county's territory under the pretext of hunting bandits, causing disturbances wherever they went.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect transferred Fu to serve as assistant magistrate of Luyi; the eunuch Yang Fengzhou led two hundred soldiers into the county under the pretext of hunting bandits, causing disturbances wherever they went.

sentences.zh: 僎檄逢周取所受文書，逢周不與，僎令尉譏察之。

translations.literal: Fu issued an order to Fengzhou to produce the documents he had received; Fengzhou would not comply, and Fu had the lieutenant investigate him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu issued an order requiring Fengzhou to produce the documents he had received; Fengzhou refused, and Fu had the lieutenant investigate him.

sentences.zh: 逢同歸，訴於徽宗，詔逮僎赴開封府獄，獄以狀聞，乃使還任。

translations.literal: Fengzhou returned and lodged a complaint with Emperor Huizong; an edict ordered Fu seized and sent to the Kaifeng prefectural prison. The prison reported the facts, and he was then sent back to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou returned and lodged a complaint with Emperor Huizong; an edict ordered Fu seized and sent to the Kaifeng prefectural prison. The prison reported the facts of the case, and he was then sent back to his post.

sentences.zh: 辟權咸平縣丞。

translations.literal: He was recruited to serve as acting Assistant Magistrate of Xianping County.
translations.idiomatic: He was recruited to serve as acting Assistant Magistrate of Xianping County.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，勤王兵有剽掠邑界者，僎率民兵擊之，得犯者斬以徇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jingkang era, troops coming to the emperor's aid were plundering within the county's borders; Fu led the militia against them, captured the offenders, and executed them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingkang era, troops coming to the emperor's aid were plundering within the county's borders; Fu led the militia against them, captured the offenders, and executed them as a warning.

sentences.zh: 會金人大至，力不敵，其僚欲降之，僎走南京從趙野乞師，不從，慟哭而歸。

translations.literal: When Jin forces arrived in great numbers and he could not match them, his subordinates wished to surrender; Fu fled to Nanjing to beg Zhao Ye for reinforcements, but Ye would not comply, and Fu returned weeping.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin forces arrived in overwhelming numbers, his subordinates wished to surrender; Fu fled to Nanjing to beg Zhao Ye for reinforcements, but Ye refused, and Fu returned in tears.

sentences.zh: 尋知宣城縣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed prefect of Xuancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed prefect of Xuancheng County.

sentences.zh: 苗傅、劉正彥之變，呂頤浩傳檄諸郡，僎說郡守劉玨，請募勇士倍道赴難，揭榜復用建炎年號，人皆韙之。

translations.literal: During the rebellion of Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan, Lu Yihao issued proclamations to the commanderies; Fu persuaded the prefect Liu Jue to recruit brave men and hurry to the rescue by forced marches, posted notices restoring the Jianyan reign title, and the people all approved.
translations.idiomatic: During the rebellion of Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan, Lu Yihao issued proclamations to the commanderies; Fu persuaded the prefect Liu Jue to recruit brave men and hurry to the rescue by forced marches, posted notices restoring the Jianyan reign title, and the people all approved.

sentences.zh: 通判全州，權饒州浮梁宰，未行，時有賊張頂花者已逼縣境，眾止之，僎曰：「安逸則就，艱危則辭，非我所學。

translations.literal: He served as Vice Prefect of Quanzhou and acting Magistrate of Fuliang in Raozhou; before he could take up the post, a bandit named Zhang Dinghua had already pressed close to the county border. The crowd tried to stop him, but Fu said, "To accept ease and refuse hardship is not what I have learned.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Vice Prefect of Quanzhou and acting Magistrate of Fuliang in Raozhou; before he could take up the post, a bandit named Zhang Dinghua had already pressed close to the county border. The crowd tried to stop him, but Fu said, "To accept ease and refuse hardship is not what I have learned.

sentences.zh: 」徑就道。

translations.literal: " He went straight on his way.
translations.idiomatic: " He went straight on his way.

sentences.zh: 至縣，約束吏士，誓以死戰。

translations.literal: When he reached the county he imposed discipline on clerks and soldiers and swore to fight to the death.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the county he imposed discipline on clerks and soldiers and swore to fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 賊聞之，偽降，入邑為變，邑官竄伏，僎曰：「吾為宰，義不可去。

translations.literal: When the bandits heard this they feigned surrender, entered the county, and staged a mutiny; the county officials fled and hid themselves. Fu said, "As magistrate, it is my duty not to leave.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits heard this they feigned surrender, entered the county, and staged a mutiny; the county officials fled and hid. Fu said, "As magistrate, it is my duty not to leave.

sentences.zh: 」端坐公署，賊徒責僎，僎大罵不絕口，遂遇害。

translations.literal: " He sat upright in the public office; the bandits reproached Fu, and Fu cursed them without cease, then was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " He sat upright in the public office; the bandits reproached him, and Fu cursed them without cease until they killed him.

sentences.zh: 詔贈承議郎，錄其後二人。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made him a Gentleman for Discussion on Proposals, and two of his descendants were granted official appointments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made him a Gentleman for Discussion on Proposals and granted official appointments to two of his descendants.

sentences.zh: 郭讚者，汝陽縣丞也。

translations.literal: Guo Zan was assistant magistrate of Ruyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zan was assistant magistrate of Ruyang County.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，金人陷蔡州，守臣閻孝忠聞之，先遣其家，獨聚軍民守城。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, when the Jin took Caizhou, the defending official Yan Xiaozhong, upon hearing this, first sent away his family and alone gathered soldiers and civilians to hold the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jianyan era, when the Jin took Caizhou, the defending official Yan Xiaozhong, upon hearing the news, first sent away his family and alone gathered soldiers and civilians to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 金人陷城，孝忠為所執，見其貌陋且侏儒，乃令荷擔，因乘間而逃。

translations.literal: When the Jin took the city, Xiaozhong was captured; seeing that he was ugly and dwarfish, they made him carry loads, and he escaped when he found an opening.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin took the city, Xiaozhong was captured; seeing that he was ugly and dwarfish, they made him carry loads, and he escaped when he found an opening.

sentences.zh: 獨讚朝服詬叱不肯降，遂見殺。

translations.literal: Zan alone, in court robes, cursed and reviled them and refused to surrender; he was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zan alone, in court robes, cursed and reviled them and refused to surrender; he was then killed.

sentences.zh: 王迸字純父，饒州樂平人。

translations.literal: Wang Beng, styled Chunfu, was a native of Leping in Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Beng, courtesy name Chunfu, was a native of Leping in Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 鄉舉恩免，為固始簿，攝邑。

translations.literal: Through the district examination with exemption from further testing, he became registrar of Gushi and acted as magistrate of the county.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the district examination with exemption from further testing, he became registrar of Gushi and acted as magistrate of the county.

sentences.zh: 紹定中，金兵犯淮，守令望風遁，迸度力不能禦，懷印自投於井而死。

translations.literal: During the Shaoding era, when Jin troops violated the Huai, the prefect and magistrate fled at the first sign of danger; Beng judged that his strength could not resist them, clasped the seal to himself, and threw himself into a well to die.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoding era, when Jin troops crossed the Huai, the prefect and magistrate fled at the first sign of danger; Beng judged that he lacked the strength to resist, clasped the seal to himself, and threw himself into a well to die.

sentences.zh: 吳從龍字子雲，官至武功郎、建康府統製。

translations.literal: Wu Conglong, styled Ziyun, rose to the rank of Martial Achievement Gentleman and Commander of Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Conglong, courtesy name Ziyun, rose to the rank of Martial Achievement Gentleman and Commander of Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹定兵難，為先鋒，援不至，被擒，使至泰州城下誘降，終不屈，死之。

translations.literal: During the military crisis of Shaoding he served as vanguard; when reinforcements did not arrive he was captured and was brought beneath the walls of Taizhou to induce surrender, but in the end he would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the military crisis of the Shaoding era he served as vanguard; when reinforcements failed to arrive he was captured and brought beneath the walls of Taizhou to induce surrender, but in the end he refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 廟祀揚、泰二州，賜額褒忠。

translations.literal: Temples were established for him in Yang and Tai Prefectures, and the name Baozhong was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Temples were established for him in Yang and Tai Prefectures, and the name Baozhong was bestowed upon them.

sentences.zh: 官其弟從虎，至武經大夫。

translations.literal: His younger brother Conghu was given an official appointment and rose to Grand Master of Martial Classics.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Conghu was given an official appointment and rose to the rank of Grand Master of Martial Classics.

sentences.zh: 司馬夢求，敘州人，溫國公光之後也。

translations.literal: Sima Mengqiu was a native of Xuzhou and a descendant of Duke Wen of Wen, Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Mengqiu was a native of Xuzhou and a descendant of Duke Wen of Wen, Sima Guang.

sentences.zh: 母程，歸及門，夫死，誓不它適，旌其門曰「節婦」。
