translations.literal: His mother, née Cheng, had just reached the door when her husband died; she vowed never to marry again, and her gate was honored with the title "Chaste Widow."
translations.idiomatic: His mother, née Cheng, had just reached the door when her husband died; she vowed never to marry again, and her gate was honored with the title "Chaste Widow."

sentences.zh: 夢求，其族子，取以為後。

translations.literal: Mengqiu was a clansman; she took him as her adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: Mengqiu was a clansman; she took him as her adopted son.

sentences.zh: 景定三年，舉進士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingding he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jingding era he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 咸淳末，調江陵沙市監鎮。

translations.literal: At the end of Xianchun he was transferred to serve as supervisor of Shashi in Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Xianchun era he was transferred to serve as supervisor of Shashi in Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 沙市距城才十五里，南阻蜀江，北倚江陵，地勢險固，為舟車之會，恃水為防。

translations.literal: Shashi was only fifteen li from the city; south it was blocked by the Shu River, north it leaned on Jiangling. The terrain was steep and secure, a meeting place of boats and carts, and it relied on water for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Shashi lay only fifteen li from the city; to the south it was blocked by the Shu River, to the north it leaned on Jiangling. The terrain was steep and secure, a crossroads of boats and carts, and it relied on water for its defense.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，湖水忽涸，北兵橫遏中道，乘南風縱火，都統程文亮逆戰於馬頭岸，製置使高達束手不援，文亮降。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou the lake waters suddenly dried up; Northern troops blocked the middle route, took advantage of the south wind to set fires, and the Commander-in-Chief Cheng Wenliang met them in battle at Matou Bank; the Commissioner Gao Da stood by with folded hands and gave no aid, and Wenliang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Deyou era the lake waters suddenly dried up; Northern troops blocked the middle route, took advantage of the south wind to set fires, and the Commander-in-Chief Cheng Wenliang met them in battle at Matou Bank; the Commissioner Gao Da stood by with folded hands and gave no aid, and Wenliang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夢求朝服望闕再拜，自經死。

translations.literal: Mengqiu, in court robes, bowed toward the palace twice, and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Mengqiu, in court robes, bowed twice toward the palace, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 林空齋，永福人，失其名。

translations.literal: Lin Kongzhai was a native of Yongfu; his personal name is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Kongzhai was a native of Yongfu; his personal name is lost.

sentences.zh: 父同，官至監丞。

translations.literal: His father Tong rose to the rank of Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tong rose to the rank of Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 空齋舉進士，曆知縣，解官家居。

translations.literal: Kongzhai passed the jinshi examination, served in succession as county magistrate, resigned from office, and lived at home.
translations.idiomatic: Kongzhai passed the jinshi examination, served in succession as county magistrate, resigned from office, and lived at home.

sentences.zh: 益王立，張世傑圍泉州，乃率鄉人黃必大、劉仝祖即其家開忠義局，起義兵，復永福縣。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi was established, Zhang Shijie besieged Quanzhou; he then led his fellow villagers Huang Bida and Liu Quanzu to open a Loyalty and Righteousness Bureau at his home, raised a righteous militia, and recovered Yongfu County.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yi was established, Zhang Shijie besieged Quanzhou; Kongzhai then led his fellow villagers Huang Bida and Liu Quanzu to open a Loyalty and Righteousness Bureau at his home, raised a righteous militia, and recovered Yongfu County.

sentences.zh: 時王積翁以福安送款世傑，然實密約北兵。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Jinweng surrendered Fu'an to Shijie, yet in fact he secretly arranged with the Northern troops.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wang Jinweng surrendered Fu'an to Shijie, yet in fact he secretly arranged with the Northern troops.

sentences.zh: 兵至，屠永福，必大、仝祖等走它邑。

translations.literal: When the troops arrived they massacred Yongfu; Bida, Quanzu, and the others fled to other counties.
translations.idiomatic: When the troops arrived they massacred Yongfu; Bida, Quanzu, and the others fled to other counties.

sentences.zh: 空齋盛服坐堂上，齧指血書壁云：「生為忠義臣，死為忠義鬼。

translations.literal: Kongzhai, in full ceremonial dress, sat in the hall, bit his finger and wrote in blood on the wall: "Living, I am a loyal and righteous minister; dead, I am a loyal and righteous ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Kongzhai, in full ceremonial dress, sat in the hall, bit his finger and wrote in blood on the wall: "Living, I am a loyal and righteous minister; dead, I am a loyal and righteous ghost.

sentences.zh: 草間雖可活，吾不忍為爾。

translations.literal: One might live among the grass, but I am unwilling to do so for you.
translations.idiomatic: One might live among the grass, but I am unwilling to do so for you.

sentences.zh: 諸君何為者，自古皆有死。

translations.literal: What are you all doing? Since ancient times all men must die.
translations.idiomatic: What are you all doing? Since ancient times all men must die.

sentences.zh: 」俄見執，不屈而死。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward he was seized and, refusing to submit, died.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward he was seized and, refusing to submit, died.

sentences.zh: 妻劉被掠，子用中逃，得不死。

translations.literal: His wife Liu was seized; his son Yongzhong escaped and was not killed.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Liu was seized; his son Yongzhong escaped and was not killed.

sentences.zh: 乃壯，求母四方，逾十年，得於京師以歸，州裏稱為黃孝子雲。

translations.literal: When he came of age he searched for his mother in all directions; after more than ten years he found her in the capital and brought her home, and the prefecture and district called him Filial Son Huang Yun.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he searched for his mother in all directions; after more than ten years he found her in the capital and brought her home, and the prefecture and district called him Filial Son Huang Yun.

sentences.zh: 孫益，揚州泰興人。

translations.literal: Sun Yi was a native of Taixing in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yi was a native of Taixing in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 少豪俠。

translations.literal: From youth he was bold and chivalrous.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was bold and chivalrous.

sentences.zh: 紹定中，李全犯楊州，遊騎薄泰興城下，縣令王爚募人守禦，益起從之。

translations.literal: During Shaoding, when Li Quan violated Yangzhou, roaming cavalry pressed close beneath the walls of Taixing; the magistrate Wang Shuo recruited men for defense, and Yi rose to join him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoding era, when Li Quan violated Yangzhou, roaming cavalry pressed close beneath the walls of Taixing; the magistrate Wang Shuo recruited men for defense, and Yi rose to join him.

sentences.zh: 俄賊兵大至，益率眾拒之。

translations.literal: Soon the bandit troops arrived in force, and Yi led the crowd to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the bandit troops arrived in force, and Yi led the crowd to resist them.

sentences.zh: 眾見賊勢盛，且前且卻，益厲聲呼曰：「王令君募我來，將以守護城邑也。

translations.literal: Seeing the bandits' strength, the men advanced and retreated by turns; Yi shouted in a stern voice, "Magistrate Wang recruited us to come here in order to defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the bandits' strength, the men advanced and retreated by turns; Yi shouted in a stern voice, "Magistrate Wang recruited us to come here in order to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 今賊至城下，我輩不為一死，復何面目見令君乎？

translations.literal: Now that the bandits are at the city walls, if we do not die for this cause, with what face can we meet the magistrate?
translations.idiomatic: Now that the bandits are at the city walls, if we do not die for this cause, with what face can we meet the magistrate?

sentences.zh: 」遂身先赴敵，死之。

translations.literal: " He then took the lead and charged the enemy and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He then took the lead, charged the enemy, and died.

sentences.zh: 同時顧緒、顧珣俱戰死。

translations.literal: At the same time Gu Xu and Gu Xun also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Gu Xu and Gu Xun also died in battle.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈益保義郎，緒、珣承節郎，各官其子一人。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Yi was posthumously made Defender of Righteousness, Xu and Xun were made Gentlemen for Upholding Integrity, and each of their sons was granted an official appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, Yi was posthumously made Defender of Righteousness, Xu and Xun were made Gentlemen for Upholding Integrity, and each of their sons was granted an official appointment.

sentences.zh: 王仙，蜀都統也。

translations.literal: Wang Xian was a Commander-in-Chief of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xian was a Commander-in-Chief of Shu.

sentences.zh: 守涪州，北兵攻圍無虛日，勢孤援絕。

translations.literal: He held Fuzhou; Northern troops attacked and besieged it without a day's respite, and he was isolated with no reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: He held Fuzhou; Northern troops attacked and besieged it without a day's respite, and he was isolated with no reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 宋亡之二年，城始破，仙自刎，斷其亢不殊，以兩手自摘其首墜死。

translations.literal: In the second year after Song's fall the city was at last broken; Xian cut his own throat, severed his neck almost completely, and with both hands tore off his own head and fell dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year after Song's fall the city was at last broken; Xian cut his own throat, severed his neck almost completely, and with both hands tore off his own head and fell dead.

sentences.zh: 曹琦，蜀進士也。

translations.literal: Cao Qi was a jinshi of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Qi was a jinshi of Shu.

sentences.zh: 知南平軍，亦被執，脫身南歸，製置辟主管機宜文字。

translations.literal: He was prefect of Nanping Army; he too was captured, escaped south, and was recruited by the Commissioner to serve as Supervisor of Staff Planning.
translations.idiomatic: He was prefect of Nanping Army; he too was captured, escaped south, and was recruited by the Commissioner to serve as Supervisor of Staff Planning.

sentences.zh: 聞都統趙安以城降，就守禦地自經死。

translations.literal: When he heard that Commander-in-Chief Zhao An had surrendered the city, he went to the defensive post and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that Commander-in-Chief Zhao An had surrendered the city, he went to the defensive post and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 楚材既失利，且乏援，大元兵誘降，其眾多解去。

translations.literal: After Chucai had suffered defeat and lacked reinforcements, the Great Yuan troops tried to induce surrender, and many of his followers dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: After Chucai had suffered defeat and lacked reinforcements, the Great Yuan troops tried to induce surrender, and many of his followers dispersed.

sentences.zh: 楚材走光澤，為人所執，及其子應登以獻。

translations.literal: Chucai fled to Guangze and was seized by others; he and his son Yingdeng were presented as captives.
translations.idiomatic: Chucai fled to Guangze and was seized; he and his son Yingdeng were presented as captives.

sentences.zh: 郡遣錄事婁南良訊之曰：「汝何為錯舉？

translations.literal: The prefect dispatched the Recorder Lou Nanliang to interrogate him, saying, "Why did you make the wrong choice?
translations.idiomatic: The prefect dispatched the Recorder Lou Nanliang to interrogate him, saying, "Why did you make the wrong choice?

sentences.zh: 」楚材抗聲曰：「不錯，不錯。

translations.literal: " Chucai answered in a loud voice, "Not wrong, not wrong.
translations.idiomatic: " Chucai answered in a loud voice, "Not wrong, not wrong.

sentences.zh: 如府錄所為，乃大錯爾。

translations.literal: What the Recorder did is the great wrong.
translations.idiomatic: What the Recorder did is the great wrong.

sentences.zh: 府錄受宋官爵，今乃為敵用事，還思身上綠袍自何而得？

translations.literal: The Recorder received Song office and rank; now he serves the enemy—does he ever think from where the green robe on his back came?
translations.idiomatic: The Recorder received Song office and rank; now he serves the enemy—does he ever think from where the green robe on his back came?

sentences.zh: 吾一鄙儒，特為忠義所激，為國出力，事雖不成，正不錯也。

translations.literal: I am but a humble scholar, stirred only by loyalty and righteousness to exert myself for the state; though the affair did not succeed, I am certainly not wrong.
translations.idiomatic: I am but a humble scholar, stirred only by loyalty and righteousness to exert myself for the state; though the affair did not succeed, I am certainly not wrong.

sentences.zh: 」南良愧而語塞。

translations.literal: " Nanliang was ashamed and left speechless.
translations.idiomatic: " Nanliang was ashamed and left speechless.

sentences.zh: 及吳浚為江西製置、招討使，斬楚材父子，傳首諸邑。

translations.literal: When Wu Jun served as Jiangxi Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner, he executed Chucai and his son and sent their heads to the various counties.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Jun served as Jiangxi Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner, he executed Chucai and his son and sent their heads to the various counties.

sentences.zh: 益王立於福州，聞而哀之，贈官朝奉郎，即邵武境上立廟，賜名忠勇。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi was established at Fuzhou and heard of this, he mourned them and posthumously made Chucai a Gentleman for Court Audience; a temple was established on the border of Shaowu and given the name Zhongyong.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yi was established at Fuzhou and heard of this, he mourned them and posthumously made Chucai a Gentleman for Court Audience; a temple was established on the border of Shaowu and given the name Zhongyong.

sentences.zh: 李成大，字實夫，南康軍建昌人，文定公李迪之從子也。

translations.literal: Li Chengda, styled Shifu, was a native of Jianchang in Nankang Army and a nephew of Li Di, Duke of Wending.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengda, courtesy name Shifu, was a native of Jianchang in Nankang Army and a nephew of Li Di, Duke of Wending.

sentences.zh: 寶祐四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Baoyou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of the Baoyou era.

sentences.zh: 德祐初，知金壇縣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Deyou he was prefect of Jintan County.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Deyou era he was prefect of Jintan County.

sentences.zh: 北兵至，與寄居官潘大同、大本率民兵巷戰，不勝，大同兄弟死之。

translations.literal: When Northern troops arrived, he and the resident officials Pan Datong and Daben led the militia in street fighting; they could not prevail, and the Datong brothers died.
translations.idiomatic: When Northern troops arrived, he and the resident officials Pan Datong and Daben led the militia in street fighting; they could not prevail, and the Datong brothers died.

sentences.zh: 吏民挾成大降，乃潛與胡用存謀復金壇，事泄係獄，搒掠不屈，遂殺其二子以懼之，終不屈，笑曰：「子為父死，臣為君死。

translations.literal: Clerks and people forced Chengda to surrender; he then secretly plotted with Hu Yongcun to recover Jintan, but the affair was exposed and he was imprisoned; though beaten and tortured he would not submit, and they killed his two sons to intimidate him, yet he still would not submit and laughed, saying, "Sons die for fathers, ministers die for rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks and people forced Chengda to surrender; he then secretly plotted with Hu Yongcun to recover Jintan, but the plot was exposed and he was imprisoned; though beaten and tortured he would not submit, and they killed his two sons to intimidate him, yet he still refused to submit and laughed, saying, "Sons die for fathers, ministers die for rulers.

sentences.zh: 」卒殺之。

translations.literal: " In the end they killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end they killed him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈朝散大夫、直秘閣，諡忠節。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Grand Master for Spreading Goodness and Direct Attendant of the Privy Repository, with the posthumous title Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Grand Master for Spreading Goodness and Direct Attendant of the Privy Repository, with the posthumous title Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: 製曰：「外難方熾，擁名城數十而降者，相望也。

translations.literal: The edict said: "While foreign calamity blazed, those holding famous cities by the dozens surrendered one after another.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: "While foreign calamity blazed, those holding famous cities by the dozens surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 守封疆之臣，父忠於前，子繼於後，如晉卞氏，可無褒乎？

translations.literal: Ministers guarding the frontiers whose fathers were loyal before and whose sons continued after, like the Bian clan of Jin—should they not be honored?
translations.idiomatic: Ministers guarding the frontiers whose fathers were loyal before and whose sons continued after, like the Bian clan of Jin—should they not be honored?

sentences.zh: 通直郎、知鎮江府金壇縣兼弓手砦兵正李成大勁氣排霄，精忠貫日，壯誌弗就，以沒其身。

translations.literal: Palace Gentleman for Direct Remonstrance, Prefect of Jintan County in Zhenjiang Prefecture and concurrently Commander of the Archer Stronghold Militia, Li Chengda—his fierce spirit pierced the heavens, his pure loyalty ran through the sun; his great resolve unfulfilled, he perished in the course of duty.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Gentleman for Direct Remonstrance, Prefect of Jintan County in Zhenjiang Prefecture and concurrently Commander of the Archer Stronghold Militia, Li Chengda—his fierce spirit pierced the heavens, his pure loyalty ran through the sun; his great resolve unfulfilled, he perished in the course of duty.

sentences.zh: 襚以大夫之階，官其二孤，用慰英爽。」

translations.literal: Let him be enrobed with the rank of Grand Master and his two orphaned sons be given office, to comfort his heroic spirit."
translations.idiomatic: Let him be enrobed with the rank of Grand Master and his two orphaned sons be given office, to comfort his heroic spirit."

sentences.zh: 陶居仁，太平之蕪湖人。

translations.literal: Tao Juren was a native of Wuhu in Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Juren was a native of Wuhu in Taiping.

sentences.zh: 以行義聞州裏。

translations.literal: He was known throughout the prefecture and district for righteous conduct.
translations.idiomatic: He was known throughout the prefecture and district for righteous conduct.

sentences.zh: 仕為鎮江錄事參軍。

translations.literal: He served as Recorder of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Recorder of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 北兵攻鎮江，守臣洪起畏遁，統製官石祖忠舉城降，居仁見執，抑使降。

translations.literal: When Northern troops attacked Zhenjiang, the defending official Hong Qikui fled, and the Commander Shizu Zhong surrendered the city; Juren was seized and compelled to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Northern troops attacked Zhenjiang, the defending official Hong Qikui fled, and the Commander Shizu Zhong surrendered the city; Juren was seized and compelled to surrender.

sentences.zh: 居仁曰：「吾固知曆數窮而世運更也，詎可失忠義求苟生邪？

translations.literal: Juren said, "I have long known that the dynastic mandate is exhausted and the age is changing; how could I abandon loyalty and righteousness to seek a shameful life?
translations.idiomatic: Juren said, "I have long known that the dynastic mandate is exhausted and the age is changing; how could I abandon loyalty and righteousness to seek a shameful life?

sentences.zh: 得以死報朝廷，夫何憾。

translations.literal: To be able to die repaying the court—what regret could there be?
translations.idiomatic: To be able to die repaying the court—what regret could there be?

sentences.zh: 」竟不屈，遂見殺。

translations.literal: " In the end he would not submit and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he would not submit and was then killed.

sentences.zh: 大帥至，聞居仁死時語，歎嘖之，為棺斂，使人護以還其家。

translations.literal: When the supreme commander arrived and heard Juren's words at the time of his death, he sighed in admiration, provided a coffin for his burial, and sent men to escort him back to his family.
translations.idiomatic: When the supreme commander arrived and heard Juren's words at the time of his death, he sighed in admiration, provided a coffin for his burial, and sent men to escort him back to his family.

sentences.zh: 逆流數百里，不時頃至，人皆異之。

translations.literal: Against the current for several hundred li, he arrived in no time at all; all regarded it as extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: Against the current for several hundred li, the coffin arrived in no time at all; all regarded it as extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 鄉人為立祠。

translations.literal: The people of his district established a shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of his district established a shrine for him.
